summary.root_cause_text: Ops config change pointed payment_provider_url to internal://payments-v2 (unreachable), so the worker processed orders without payments (logged only at DEBUG). Worker thread stalled in wait state (heartbeat age 16.1s), so the queue backlog kept growing.
recommended: Validate provider reachability before migrating to payments-v2
Alert on payment provider failures logged at DEBUG
Investigate why the worker stalled in wait state
